description: Electrolineras Públicas en México is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE). El directorio ofrece datos de identificación, ubicación, potencia, modelo de cargadores, teléfonos de contacto y número de cargadores de las diferentes electrolineras públicas y privadas de la República Mexicana. Se utiliza para conocer el crecimiento de la industria de movilidad eléctrica en México, lo que sirve para consulta de información de acceso público. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE). Its tags are carro, consumo electricidad, demanda energética, fuente energética, industria automotriz. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
